title: Americold Announces Upsizing and Extension of New Sustainability-Linked Senior Unsecured Credit Facilities
description: ATLANTA, GA., Aug.  24, 2022  (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Americold Realty Trust, Inc. (NYSE: COLD) (“Americold” or the “Company”), the world’s largest publicly traded REIT focused on the ownership, operation, acquisition, and development of temperature-controlled warehouses, announced today it has extended and upsized its senior unsecured credit facilities from $1.5 billion to approximately $2.0 billion. The refinance closed on August 23, 2022.   The senior unsecured credit facilities enhance the Company’s strong liquidity position and extend its well-staggered debt maturity profile.
